summary: The fail module stops execution with a custom message, typically combined with when, and works on Windows too.
questions: How do I stop a playbook with a custom error when a condition is true?
Is there a module to deliberately fail a task?

answer_card.title: Stop with a custom error using fail
answer_card.answer_md: `ansible.builtin.fail` fails the task with a custom message. Combine with `when:` to bail out on a condition. Works on Windows.
